Power 
 Station

Technical 
 Procedure
Equipment:
Flow Control Valves,
Pressure Control Valves
FISHER
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
I1 which must be performed on yearly bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

The flow control 
valves and and pressure control valves types and function as follows:

to 
 control and regulate the fuel gas flow and working parallel with 
 PCV-16A.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
 Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general 
 director eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, approved by eng. Mohamed 
 El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

This document revised by eng. Nageh 
Soliman Shousha: CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. 
Afaf Ebrahim El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS 
coordinator.
Safety Precautions

Work order must be issued and the
qualified maintenance staff should the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and health equipment as safety helmet, 
safety shoes, gloves
 etc.
Isolate air instrument

Purging lines by nitrogen and
confirm the vents is hydrocarbon free

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Work to be Carried Out

Inspect internal parts (plug,
cage, piston rings, seats) and replace damage parts if there is high wear or 
cracks in 
this parts.

Packing inspection 
and change if needed.

Stroke the V/V with IMD 
by readjusting the stroke from 0% to 25% to 50% to 100%

Re-grease the isolation V/Vs and check
the gear box from wear or cracks and change the defected parts.
